summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #296 (SDK extraction), then diagnose and fix recurring E2E CI test failures stemming from those changes.
summary.outcome: All PR review comments were resolved across multiple review rounds. CI failures were traced to missing package builds in workflows, a broken `ensureFolderRegistered` guard, and `__ZUSTAND_STORES` only being exposed in dev builds. A minimal `window.__E2E` test helper was implemented gated behind `VITE_E2E=true`, store access was replaced with UI-based checks where possible, and a race condition in the helper's async initialization was fixed.

repo: The CI E2E workflow only built `@cipherbox/crypto`, `@cipherbox/api`, and `@cipherbox/web` — it was missing the new packages (`core`, `api-client`, `sdk-core`, `sdk`) introduced in PR #296, causing build failures.
`__ZUSTAND_STORES` was gated behind `import.meta.env.DEV` in `main.tsx`, so it was never available in production/CI builds, silently breaking all E2E tests that polled vault or store state.

Release Please with multiple components uses the target branch name ('main') in the PR title when `${version}` is specified, because there is no single version across components. Top-level `pull-request-title-pattern` without `${version}` is the correct config.

Independent package versioning with Release Please works correctly from the second release onward — the first PR bumps all packages together because a single commit (PR #296) touched all of them simultaneously.

The `ensureFolderRegistered` guard added from a Copilot review comment checked `isLoaded` which is not set in all code paths (SDK-created folders, root folder after vault init), silently skipping registration and causing 'Folder not loaded' errors in production.
The `FolderTree.clear()` method zeros all stored key buffers, meaning `registerFolder` storing caller-owned buffers is a real security concern — `destroy()` would zero the caller's keys.
Public keys are displayed on the Settings page at `.settings-pubkey-value`, making them accessible via UI without needing store access.
The `deploy-staging.yml` workflow has separate build steps for web and three desktop (Tauri) platform builds — all needed the same package dependency chain fix.
The `orval` codegen tool generates incorrect types for nullable `Date` fields (`{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null`) — regenerating produces the same wrong output.

code.finding: Vault store was dynamically imported inside an async `import().then()` for `__E2E` exposure, causing a race condition where conflict-detection tests would read `window.__E2E` as undefined before the promise resolved. Fix: use static imports.

`ensureFolderRegistered` had an `isLoaded` guard that was too strict — folders loaded via SDK `createFolder` or vault init have valid keys but `isLoaded` may be false. Only key material emptiness is the correct safety condition.

`registerFolder` stored caller-owned key buffers directly. `FolderTree.clear()` (called by `destroy()`) zeros all stored key buffers, which would corrupt the caller's key material. Fix: defensive copies on registration, return copies from `getFolderIpnsPrivateKey`.
`createFolder` leaked plaintext `folderKey` and `ipnsPrivateKey` on exception. Fix: move duplicate-name check before key generation, wrap key usage in try/catch with `clearBytes` on failure.

Vault readiness was polled via `__ZUSTAND_STORES` checking for `rootFolderKey`. This can be replaced by waiting for the file list or empty-state UI element to appear, which is already done by callers.

Test 3.7 polled `window.__ZUSTAND_STORES?.vault` for `rootFolderKey` after reload. This was the source of the persistent CI flakiness — stores not exposed in production builds. Replaced with waiting for file list UI element.

Public key was extracted from Zustand stores. Replaced with navigation to `/settings`, read from `.settings-pubkey-value`, navigation back. Added `.trim()` and assertion for non-empty `0x`-prefixed value.

workflow: When adding Playwright `addInitScript` or `exposeFunction`, these persist across `page.reload()` — mock wallets injected this way survive reloads.
Vite bakes `VITE_*` env vars at compile time — using `VITE_E2E=true` in CI workflows creates a tree-shakeable E2E-only code path without polluting production builds.
When a PR introduces new packages, all CI workflows that build dependent packages must be audited for missing build steps — build failures surface late when the downstream app build runs.
E2E tests should use UI state (visible elements) rather than internal store state wherever possible. Store access should be the last resort, not the first.
When merging a PR before a fix commit lands, the fix must be applied fresh from main on a new branch — commits pushed to a merged PR branch don't make it to main.

friction: PR #296 was already merged before the CI workflow fix was pushed, requiring the workflow fix to be redone on a new branch from main.
The `isLoaded` guard added in response to a valid Copilot review comment immediately broke production — the reviewer's suggestion was sound in principle but the flag wasn't set in all code paths.
Background `pnpm test` runs required polling `TaskOutput` to check results, with no way to know when they'd complete.

The E2E failure root cause (`__ZUSTAND_STORES` not available in production builds) was masked because 3.7 always failed first, causing 36+ subsequent tests to be skipped — the broader pattern wasn't visible until investigating.
TypeScript's strict `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` vs `BlobPart` incompatibility required a `as BlobPart` cast when removing the unnecessary `.buffer` unwrap.
The `orval` codegen bug (nullable Date → wrong union type) cannot be fixed by regenerating — it requires an upstream fix or manual override.
Resolving GitHub PR threads requires two separate API calls (REST for reply, GraphQL mutation for resolve) with different parameter formats (`--field` integer vs `--raw-field` string).
open_items: Conflict-detection tests still use `window.__E2E` (via `VITE_E2E` flag) for `accessToken` and `rootIpnsName` — `rootIpnsName` is not exposed in the UI so full store elimination isn't yet possible for this test.
`web3auth-helpers.ts` (email-based test login) still references `__ZUSTAND_STORES` but is considered legacy — not actively used by wallet-based tests but not yet deleted.
The `orval`-generated `VaultResponseDtoInitializedAt` type is incorrect (nullable Date generates wrong union type) — flagged as not fixable by regenerating, needs upstream fix or manual override.
The concurrent folder mutation concern (Thread 2 from first review round) was marked not applicable — architectural improvement deferred to a follow-up.
E2E desktop workflows (`e2e-desktop.yml`) were updated to include new package build steps, but desktop E2E tests were not run to verify the fix.
Test 3.7 timeout was increased from 240s to 360s as a workaround — the underlying Sapphire Devnet session restore latency on CI is a known flakiness source that may still occasionally cause failures.
